script: Cycling to work is good for your health, your wallet and your city. A short ride every morning wakes up your body and clears your mind before the day begins. You skip the traffic jams, you never search for parking, and you spend almost nothing on fuel. Start with a simple, comfortable bicycle and a helmet that fits well. Plan a route on quieter streets or bike lanes, and try it once on a weekend before your first working day. Carry a small bag with a spare tube, a pump and a rain jacket. Use lights at the front and back when it gets dark, and always signal before you turn. If your office is far away, ride to a train or bus station and finish the journey there. After a few weeks, the ride will feel easy, and you may even look forward to it. Fewer cars on the road also means cleaner air for everyone. Many cities now add new bike lanes every year, so the ride keeps getting safer. Check your tyres and brakes once a month, and your bicycle will serve you well for years.
